item.title: Become an Animal Add-On
item.creator: Bunny Studios
item.description:
Ever wanted to transform into powerful furry animals?

Become an Animal lets you transform into adorable pets and their humanoid forms, battle dangerous enemies, wield unique weapons, wear fun cosmetics, and decorate your world with themed furniture!

- 6 animal forms to transform into!
- 7 pets to tame!
- By Bunny Studios

faqEntries.heading: Which animals can I transform into?
faqEntries.content:
You can transform into Humanoid Axolotl, Dragon, Fox,
Hybrid, Tiger, and Wolf.

faqEntries.heading: Can I transform into Meowl?
faqEntries.content:
No. Meowl is a support pet with a regeneration ability,
but it does not have a Transformation Item.

faqEntries.heading: Can I use my normal inventory while transformed?
faqEntries.content:
No. Transformation controls temporarily replace the
inventory slots. Return to human form to access your
stored items again.

faqEntries.heading: What happens to my inventory while transformed?
faqEntries.content:
Your inventory, armor, offhand item, enchantments,
durability, names, lore, and custom item data are stored
and restored when you return to human form.

faqEntries.heading: How do I return to human form?
faqEntries.content:
Use the Return to Human item in hotbar Slot 9. There is
a 1-second cooldown before you can transform again.

faqEntries.heading: Why did my pet not drop a Transformation Item?
faqEntries.content:
The pet must be tamed by you and fed with its matching
food. The item drops on the tenth successful feed.

howToEntries.heading: Open the Guidebook
howToEntries.content:
1. When you enter the world for the first time, the Become an Animal Guidebook appears near your
character.
2. Use the guidebook item to open the main menu and browse Transformations, Weapons, Hostile
Mobs, Armor Sets, Cosmetics, and Furniture.
3. If you lose it, craft a new guidebook with 1 Dirt and 1 Book.

howToEntries.heading: Get a Transformation Item
howToEntries.content:
1. Explore the world and find the pet version of the animal you want to become.
2. Tame the pet, then feed your tamed pet 10 times with its matching food.
3. The Transformation Item drops immediately after the tenth successful feed.
4. Meowl is a support pet and does not provide a transformation.

Axolotl - Cod or Salmon
Dragon - Beef
Fox - Sweet Berries or Glow Berries
Hybrid - Golden Carrot
Tiger - Mutton
Wolf - Bone

howToEntries.heading: Transform and Return to Human Form
howToEntries.content:
1. Use a Transformation Item. The transformation costs 2 XP levels in Survival; Creative mode has
no XP cost.
2. Your normal inventory and equipment are stored safely while the transformation controls are
active.
3. Use hotbar Slot 1 for Attack Mode and Slot 2 for Sit Mode.
4. Use the Return to Human item in hotbar Slot 9 to return to normal. Your stored inventory and
equipment are restored.

howToEntries.heading: Use the Humanoid Dragon's Flight
howToEntries.content:
1. Transform into the Humanoid Dragon.
2. Double jump to switch between normal mode and flight mode.
3. While flying, press Jump to rise and Sneak to descend.
4. Double jump again to leave flight mode. Slow Falling protects you until you land.

howToEntries.heading: Earn Special Pet Rewards
howToEntries.content:
1. Tame an Axolotl Pet to receive a Waterfall Staff. There is also a 30% chance to receive an Axolotl
Lamp and an Axolotl Scale.
2. Tame a Dragon Pet for a 30% chance to receive a Dragon Throne.
3. Tame a Tiger Pet to receive a Striped Katana, Tiger Carpet, and Tiger Fur.
4. Tame a Wolf Pet to receive a Wolf Fang Greatsword and Wolf Throne.

howToEntries.heading: Summon the Dragon Boss and Craft Its Armor
howToEntries.content:
1. Craft a Dragon Boss Spawn Egg with 1 Diamond, 1 Gold Ingot, and 1 Emerald.
2. Use the egg in a safe combat area and defeat the Dragon Boss.
3. The boss drops a Dragon Statue Spawn Egg, plus either an Electric Dragon Staff or 2-4 Dragon
Boss Scales.
4. Use Dragon Boss Scales to craft the full armor set. Wearing all four pieces grants Resistance II
and Speed II.
